title: The activity switcher does not change focus between monitors when hovering/clicking on applications.
line: Meta+Q now opens the Activities switcher on the screen you are working on, not the one where the mouse last touched a panel or the desktop.
explanation: ShellCorona::toggleActivityManager() picked the screen containing QCursor::pos(). On Wayland plasmashell only learns the pointer position while the pointer is over one of its own surfaces, so after clicking into a window on another screen the switcher still opened on the screen of the last panel or desktop contact. The change asks KWin for activeOutputName over D-Bus, the same lookup toggleWidgetExplorer() already used (now a shared helper), and falls back to the first screen if KWin doesn't answer.

commits.message:
shell: open the Activities switcher on the active screen

Meta+Q opened the Activities switcher on the screen where the pointer last
touched plasmashell, as QCursor::pos() is stale on Wayland. Ask KWin for
the active output instead, like the widget explorer already does.

BUG: 500197

media.caption: Two screens, Konsole focused on the right one: Meta+Q opens the Activities switcher on the left screen (sweep tester's shot, pure master).
Same steps with the fix: the switcher opens on the right screen, next to the focused Konsole.
The widget explorer, which now shares the helper, still opens on the active (right) screen.

review.text: Switching ShellCorona::toggleActivityManager() from stale QCursor::pos() to KWin's activeOutputName D-Bus query is the right Wayland fix and is verified on a two-output rig. However, refactoring toggleWidgetExplorer() to share desktopForActiveOutput() introduced a regression: when KWin's D-Bus reply is invalid, desktopForActiveOutput() returns nullptr and toggleWidgetExplorer() now hits Q_ASSERT_X(false, ...) (aborting debug builds) instead of falling back quietly to the first screen as before. toggleWidgetExplorer() also still dereferences *m_desktopViewForScreen.cbegin() without checking m_desktopViewForScreen.isEmpty(), unlike toggleActivityManager().
changes: Avoid triggering Q_ASSERT_X(false, ...) in ShellCorona::toggleWidgetExplorer() when the KWin activeOutputName D-Bus call fails (e.g. handle fallback to the first view cleanly or drop the stale cursorPos assert).
Guard against m_desktopViewForScreen.isEmpty() in ShellCorona::toggleWidgetExplorer() before dereferencing *m_desktopViewForScreen.cbegin(), matching toggleActivityManager().

reviews.text: Correct root cause: QCursor::pos() is stale in plasmashell on Wayland once the pointer leaves its surfaces. Using KWin's activeOutputName (which follows pointer and focus, matching the reporter's 'hover/click on applications') via a helper shared with toggleWidgetExplorer is the consistent, minimal fix in the right place. The fallback to the first view with an empty check is safe, and the before/after two-screen shots plus the close-again and widget-explorer checks are convincing. Nit: it adds another synchronous D-Bus call to KWin on the shortcut path, but toggleWidgetExplorer already does exactly that, so this is fine for a maintainer.
